description.value: Floyd's Diner is a Victoria, BC institution established in 2004, celebrated for its signature challenge dish 'The Mahoney' and generous breakfast and brunch portions. The family-oriented diner has grown to four locations across the greater Victoria area, including James Bay, Langford, Royal Oak, and the Gorge. Touring cyclists will find it a reliable all-day breakfast stop open seven days a week.
